methodology.surface: Unmodified bin/fm-dispatch-resolve.sh CLI executed via stock /bin/bash
methodology.isolation: Disposable FM_HOME, HOME, XDG config/cache, TMPDIR, quota snapshot, synthetic API key; all setup under worktree. No fleet/harness lifecycle or production credentials used.
methodology.api: Loopback HTTPS server, certificate for api.typesafe.ai; PATH wrapper delegates to real /usr/bin/curl with --connect-to and --cacert, no request/response emulation inside curl. API protocol responses intentionally supplied by disposable service.
methodology.quota: Installed real quota-axi --json --no-credential-refresh, QUOTA_AXI_SNAPSHOT cache-schema-3 synthetic Claude quota fixture. Wrapper adds controlled 0.35 s delay; failure uses invalid real CLI snapshot.
methodology.baseline: git show 86f9f36f6b7a21a879c141271d581a4a95062aa6:bin/fm-dispatch-resolve.sh and :bin/fm-timing-lib.sh materialized only in disposable directory, shared libs linked from worktree; same CLI/API/quota driven.
methodology.limitations: No paid production Jev request or model-quality evaluation; deterministic local service isolates the telemetry/privacy behavior being validated. No UI-facing change.
